resources.string: Ask Aalap for a song from any app: hold a volume key (a quick press still changes the volume), press a button of your own phone, or tap the floating Accessibility button, which you can drag anywhere. Choose which in Aalap → Profile → Voice. Aalap only looks at those buttons; it reads nothing on your screen.
Ask Aalap: say a song, artist or mood
Now playing with artwork and controls
Small player: cover, song, previous, play and next
Tap play to start your music
